repos.summary_zh: Nagram是一款基于NekoX的第三方Android Telegram客户端，内置多协议代理与丰富增强功能。它支持多账号无限登录、自定义文本样式、消息合并及语音降噪，致力于提供安全、个性化且功能全面的即时通讯体验。
repos.summary_en: Nagram is a third-party Android Telegram client built on NekoX, featuring robust built-in proxy support (VMess, SSR, Trojan, etc.) and extensive customization. It offers unlimited accounts, message combining, forced copy, voice enhancement, and advanced privacy controls, delivering a highly secure and feature-rich messaging experience.

repos.description: Save Any Telegram File to Anywhere 📂 (Alist, Disk, Webdav, S3, Rclone...) . Support restrict saving content and files beyond telegram.
repos.summary_zh: SaveAny Bot 是一款强大的 Telegram 文件自动化归档与下载工具。支持将各类媒体及受限内容批量、流式传输至本地、Alist、S3、WebDAV 等多元存储后端。集成 yt-dlp 与 Aria2，实现跨平台媒体高效自动化采集与智能分类管理。
repos.summary_en: SaveAny Bot is a powerful Telegram automation tool designed to seamlessly save files, media, and restricted content to diverse storage backends like Alist, S3, WebDAV, and local disks. It features batch downloading, streaming transfers, and chat monitoring. With integrated yt-dlp and Aria2 support, it enables automated collection and organization of media from Telegram and over 1,000 websites.

repos.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
repos.summary_zh: 基于Golang开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持Docker一键部署，日均10万次额度，通过微信原生弹窗与声音提醒实现高效通知，适用于个人及团队场景，并提供免费公共推送接口。
repos.summary_en: A minimal and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, featuring one-click Docker deployment, 100k daily pushes, native WeChat pop-up and sound alerts for efficient notifications, suitable for personal and team use with a free public API.

repos.description: 超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动联通电信，ML307R+ESP32C3
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于ESP32C3和ML307R模块打造超低成本硬件短信转发器，支持移动、联通、电信卡。通过AT指令接收短信，并利用HTTP、Bark、钉钉等7种推送通道实时转发，适用于保号与通知场景。提供Web配置界面，支持长短信合并与远程管理，硬件成本仅约27.8元。
repos.summary_en: This project implements an ultra-low-cost hardware SMS forwarder using ESP32C3 and ML307R modules, supporting China Mobile, Unicom, and Telecom SIM cards. It receives SMS via AT commands and forwards them in real-time through 7 push channels including HTTP, Bark, and DingTalk, ideal for number preservation and notifications. Features a Web configuration interface, long SMS merging, and remote management at a hardware cost of approximately ¥27.8.

repos.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）
repos.summary_zh: WebMonitor 是一款实时网页变更监控工具，支持动态抓取与灵活的数据提取。它集成邮件、微信、Telegram 等多通道通知，提供可视化界面与规则配置，助力高效实现网页信息自动化监控与告警。
repos.summary_en: WebMonitor is a real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports dynamic scraping and flexible data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications like email, WeChat, and Telegram, providing a visual UI for easy configuration and automated web info surveillance.

repos.description: 基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘。以 Telegram 为核心（支持 Webhook 直传与 2GB 扩展），并全面兼容 R2、S3、Discord 及 HuggingFace 等多存储后端。零成本构建你的全能私有数据金库。
repos.summary_zh: K-Vault 是基于 Cloudflare 的 Serverless 聚合云盘，集成 Telegram、R2、S3、Discord、HuggingFace 等多存储后端，实现零成本私有数据托管。通过 Webhook 直传与 KV 优化，提供高效上传、预览与管理，适用于个人图片分享与文件存储。
repos.summary_en: K-Vault is a Serverless aggregated cloud drive on Cloudflare, supporting Telegram, R2, S3, Discord, HuggingFace, and more for zero-cost private storage. With Webhook direct upload and KV optimization, it enables efficient file upload, preview, and management for personal image and file sharing.

repos.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
repos.summary_zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
repos.summary_en: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.

repos.summary_zh: 基于合宙Air780系列模块的短信UART转发系统，通过串口将短信实时转发至上位机。支持短信收发、来电通知、计划任务，并集成钉钉、企业微信等多渠道Webhook通知，提供Docker与原生部署方式。
repos.summary_en: This robust SMS UART forwarding system utilizes the Air780 module to relay SMS messages to a host PC over serial interface. It provides comprehensive SMS management, call alerts, scheduled messaging, rich webhook notifications (DingTalk, WeCom, Feishu), and flexible Docker or native service configurations.

repos.description: Independent, unofficial Telegram client for Android, Windows, and macOS. Sign in with your existing Telegram account — built with Flutter on TDLib.
repos.summary_zh: Navo是一款基于Flutter和TDLib构建的跨平台非官方Telegram客户端，支持Android、iOS、Windows和macOS多端登录。其核心价值在于通过跨平台技术提供独立、高效且安全的即时通讯服务，实现无缝的跨设备聊天体验。
repos.summary_en: Navo is a highly independent, unofficial Telegram client engineered to deliver a seamless, native messaging experience across Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS. Built using the Flutter framework integrated with the powerful TDLib library, it allows users to log in with their existing Telegram accounts safely. Its core strength lies in cross-platform consistency, ensuring efficient message synchronization and a robust, independent chat interface on every major desktop and mobile operating system.

repos.description: MistRelay MistRelay 是一个基于 Telegram Bot 的高性能 aria2 下载控制、Telegram 频道网盘中继与媒体流分发系统。系统将 HTTP/磁力/种子下载、Telegram 频道无限云存储、多机器人免加频道负载均衡集群、@BotFather 自动化扩容流水线、后台缩略图静默预热引擎、统一缓存生命周期治理中心以及现代毛玻璃 Web 管理中台整合至单个安全加固的 Docker 容器中。                                     官网：https://mistrelay.jiuyue520.com/
repos.summary_zh: MistRelay v3.0 是企业级多租户 Telegram 云盘与边缘流媒体分发中台，整合 Aria2 下载、AI 客服与自动化运维，实现安全隔离与高效分发。
repos.summary_en: MistRelay v3.0 is an enterprise multi-tenant Telegram cloud storage and edge streaming platform, integrating Aria2 downloads, AI service, and automated ops for secure, efficient media distribution.

repos.summary_zh: 基于Air780E硬件和LuatOS的智能短信转发系统，通过关键词与正则匹配将短信实时转发至企业微信、飞书、钉钉等平台。支持异步并发处理，自动附加设备信息，并具备低功耗与容错能力，适用于验证码接收、监控报警等场景。
repos.summary_en: An intelligent SMS forwarding system based on Air780E hardware and LuatOS, which forwards SMS to platforms like WeCom, Feishu, and DingTalk via keyword and regular matching. It supports asynchronous concurrent processing, automatically attaches device info, and features low power consumption and fault tolerance, suitable for scenarios such as verification code reception and monitoring alerts.
